tex_content.html:
If $R(x,t)=R_\mathrm {min}(t)$, then $(\partial R/\partial t)(x,t)\ge \frac{2}{n}R^2(x,t)$. \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch At a minimum $\Delta R\ge 0$; combine the scalar-curvature evolution with $|R|^2\le n|\Ric |^2$.

□

\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Forward-difference bound for the minimum scalar curvature]
